chunks: And those who drag forth with a drag.

key_terms.النَّازِعَاتِ: Those who drag or pull forth
key_terms.غَرْقًا: With a forceful drag or pulling

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'Naziat' mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: This fragment from the opening oath of Surah An-Naziat (77:1) highlights the forceful extraction of souls from the disbelievers, a concept elaborated in Shia exegesis as contrasting with the gentle departure of the righteous. The term 'gharqan' (with difficulty/struggle) underscores the spiritual and physical anguish associated with the death of those who rejected divine truth, serving as a precursor to the Day of Judgment described in the subsequent verses.
